points.description: States that steepest (gradient) descent is used to update the weights/parameters of the network during learning/training, in order to minimise the cost (error) function.
points.partial_credit: Half if only says it is used for learning/optimisation, or only mentions updating weights or minimising cost, without linking both.

points.description: States that weights are changed in the direction of steepest descent, i.e. opposite to the gradient vector of the cost function.
points.partial_credit: Half if mentions the gradient or moving downhill but does not clearly say the update is opposite to the gradient.

rubric.notes: Full marks need the role (updating weights to minimise the cost function) and the mechanism (step opposite to the gradient vector). Give half for a vague or incomplete version of either idea. Mentioning local minima or instability is optional and not required for marks. Give no marks for wrong or off-topic answers.
